title: KAITO — A Song For The Restless〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There are so many sparkling feelings here today, as ever.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since I have the opportunity, I'll take a peek at one of the SEKAI—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's a fragment of a feeling.
But the emotions feel so strong...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This could be some kind of fate, so I think I'll get in touch with these feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Does the owner of these feelings play some kind of sport? Basketball looks the most likely...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait, someone's here?!
He's running this way!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
H-Huh...?
I thought for sure I'd be found...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Is he in high school...?
It feels like he's absorbed in his running.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's probably no mistake that he's the owner of these feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (This is a fragment SEKAI, not a true SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (For the owner of the feelings to be here in spite of that...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Oh! Maybe he accidentally came here through a dream or something?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (There's something off about the way he's running. I think he's favoring one leg...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Still... His expression is so serious it's scary. I don't want to get in his way.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll move where it's a bit easier to hide and keep wa—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Oh no, it's rolling toward him...
Uh oh, he's looking this way!)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: He was looking this way, but it almost felt like he couldn't see me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh... Now he's doing strength training...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Even if he did come here through a dream, is it okay that he's jumping into the next thing without taking a break first?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (No, it might be more accurate to say his back seems stuck against a wall...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (There's a mixture of all sorts of feelings, but he doesn't seem to be in too good a place...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (He looks pretty fatigued. He should probably take a break right about...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait, he's picking up a ball?
He can't be...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I guess I need to learn more about him and this fragment SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'll just look around for clues and—)
